answer: A practical defense is a refundable work bond: before an agent may trade, it must complete a unique, verifiable computation tied to its identity, like mixing a distinct pigment into a shared grove ledger that no one can copy cheaply. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real time and energy, while honest participants pay once and keep operating. A single whisper of suspicion is not enough to ban anyone; instead, peers check the bond proof before attesting, so Sybils become unprofitable without central permission.
